basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old freelance electronics technician living in Albuquerque, New Mexico. I have a deep passion for all things tech and have been tinkering with electronics since I was a kid. When I'm not soldering circuits or coding small projects, I'm likely indulging in my love for sci-fi and fantasy, with Star Wars being a particular favorite. I'm married, and my wife shares my love for geek culture. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8-11 PM MST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Electrical Engineering from New Mexico State University. Most of my advanced knowledge comes from hands-on experience and self-teaching through countless online resources and communities. I've worked with various tech companies before going freelance, which has broadened my expertise in both hardware and software.
